correctness.rationale: The apex deletion D=* K(a_i,t−1) and link L=* K(a_i,t−2) are exact by clique locality. The (k−1)-skeleton of an (a−1)-simplex has free H_{k−1}=Λ^k ker(ε), including a=k via the zero convention. Join Künneth gives concentrated free homology of D and L; D is connected sufficiently highly that dim L < connectivity(D) for r≥2, hence attaching L→D is null, proving the two-degree sphere wedge. The long exact deletion-link sequence identifies each integral module equivariantly without assuming an equivariant homotopy splitting. Permuting join factors gives Koszul sign (−1)^k and cyclic return trace as stated. Cone boundary a_i≤t−2 follows since every vertex there avoids all forbidden t-cliques. Independently enumerated W(3,3),t=3: f=(7,21,27,9), reduced mod-2 ranks β2=4, β3=1; the signed chain Lefschetz for block swapping is −3, matching homology traces −2 in degree 2 and +1 in degree 3. Proof is symbolic for all parameters.
